flexyBayes design decisions

Source: DESIGN_DECISIONS.md

flexyBayes records its main design decisions as numbered architecture decision records (ADRs). Source comments and tests cite them by number, for example ADR 0019, and this file lists the decision behind each number. Entries in the refusal and representation registries record the decision that introduced them in a registered_in_adr field, as an ADR number or, for some entries, as the release and topic. The full records are kept by the maintainers and are not distributed with the package.

An ADR number is never reused. A decision that replaces an earlier one refers to it, and the earlier record is not edited.

The backend contract

The backend contract is the interface an inference engine must meet to be a flexyBayes backend. tests/testthat/test-backend-conformance-open-oracle.R checks both engines against it, comparing each with base R lm() and with lme4 REML fits of the same models.
